Start date: 1434-10-23 (Gregorian).  
35 weeks = 245 days.  
Add 245 + 6 = 251 days.  

1434 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but not by 400? Actually 1434 not relevant for leap year here; leap year check needed for 1435).  
From 1434-10-23:  
Days left in Oct: 8 (since 31–23).  
Nov: 30, Dec: 31 → total 8+30+31=69 days into 1435.  
251 – 69 = 182 days remaining in 1435.  

1435 is not leap (1435 mod 4 = 3).  
Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30 = 31+28+31+30+31+30 = 181 days.  
182 – 181 = 1 day into July.  

So date is 1435-07-02.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1435-07-02
